query:
SELECT 
    YEAR(entry_date) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS bahrain_visitors
FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
WHERE destination = 'البحرين'
  AND YEAR(entry_date) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
GROUP BY YEAR(entry_date)
ORDER BY year LIMIT 20000
